c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.definition: Free storage of bags before check-in or after check-out, which lets you use the city without carrying a suitcase.
c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.gloss: Free storage of bags before check-in or after check-out, which lets you use the city without carrying a suitcase.

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.definition: -<check-in>前や-<check-out>後に、-<bag>をcriteria費用で保管するサービスをいう。-<suitcase>を提げたまま街を歩かずに済む。
c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.gloss: -<check-in>前や-<check-out>後に、-<bag>をcriteria費用で保管するサービス。

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.definition: 비행기 탑승 전이나 하차 후 가방을 무료로 보관하는 장소 또는 서비스입니다. 짐을 들고 다니지 않고 도시를 둘러볼 수 있게 해 줍니다.
c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.gloss: 항공편을 이용하기 전후에 가방을 무료로 맡기는 보관소.

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.definition: Local onde se podem deixar malas e outras bagagens sem precisar carregá-las, geralmente próximo ao embarque, desembarque ou recepção de um hotel.
c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.gloss: Serviço gratuito para guardar bagagens antes de embarcar ou depois de desembarcar.

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.definition: การเก็บกระเป๋าเดินทางชั่วคราวในสถานที่ต่าง ๆ เพื่อให้ผู้เดินทางไปทำธุระได้โดยไม่ต้องถือหรือลากกระเป๋าไปด้วย
c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.gloss: บริการเก็บกระเป๋าเดินทางก่อนเช็กอินหรือหลังเช็กเอาต์

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.definition: Yolcuların eşyalarını uçuşlarından önce veya sonra geçici olarak ücretsiz bırakabildikleri hizmettir. Böylece şehirde bavul taşımadan vakit geçirebilirler.
c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.gloss: Uçağa binmeden önce veya indikten sonra bavulların bırakılabileceği ücretsiz saklama hizmeti.

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.definition: Layanan penyimpanan bagasi yang biasanya gratis dan dapat digunakan sebelum check-in atau setelah check-out. Layanan ini memungkinkan orang menjelajahi kota tanpa membawa tas atau koper.

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.text: Could you store my luggage until my flight in the evening?
c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.translation: Saya menggunakan layanan penyimpanan bagasi di hotel selama menjelajahi kota.

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.text: Could you store my luggage until my flight in the evening?
c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.translation: Uçuşum akşam olduğu için bavulumu siz saklayabilir misiniz?

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.text: Could you store my luggage until my flight in the evening?
c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.translation: มีที่เก็บกระเป๋าเดินทางให้ใช้จนถึงเวลาบินตอนเย็นไหมครับ

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.text: Could you store my luggage until my flight in the evening?
c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.translation: Podem guardar minha bagagem no guarda-volumes até o voo da noite?

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.text: Could you store my luggage until my flight in the evening?
c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.translation: 저녁 비행기까지 제 짐을 맡아 주시겠어요?

c77579388ae27413d840c615d3d3c8917038659b.text: Could you store my luggage until my flight in the evening?

c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.definition: Giving the room back and paying the final bill, usually between 10:00 and 12:00. Late check-out can often be arranged.
c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.gloss: Giving the room back and paying the final bill, usually between 10:00 and 12:00. Late check-out can often be arranged.

c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.definition: 通常は十時から十二時の間に客室を返し、代金を支払う手続きで、遅れて退还を申し込めることが多い。
c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.gloss: ホテルで部屋を返し、最終代金を支払う手続き。

c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.definition: 호텔에서 방을 돌려주고 숙박비와 다른 비용을 모두 결제하는 것으로 보통 오전 10시부터 12시 사이에 이루어집니다. 늦게 퇴실하는 것은 미리 협정하면 가능한 경우가 많습니다.
c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.gloss: 호텔에서 방을 반납하고 최종 금액을 결제하는 일.

c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.definition: Ato de devolver o quarto e pagar a conta final do hotel, normalmente entre 10h e 12h. Em muitos hotéis é possível combinar a saída tardia mediante pedido.
c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.gloss: A devolução do quarto e o pagamento da conta final, normalmente entre 10h e 12h.

c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.definition: Tindakan tamu mengembalikan kamar dan melunasi tagihan hotel, umumnya pada pukul 10.00 hingga 12.00. Check-out lebih lambat sering dapat dinegosiasikan.
c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.gloss: Proses mengembalikan kamar hotel dan membayar tagihan akhir.

c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.definition: ขั้นตอนคืนห้องพักและชำระค่าใช้จ่ายสุดท้าย โดยปกติทำระหว่าง 10:00 ถึง 12:00 และบางแห่งอาจตกลงให้คืนห้องช้ากว่าเวลาได้
c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.gloss: การคืนห้องพักและชำระค่าใช้จ่ายสุดท้ายก่อนออกจากโรงแรม

c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.definition: Odanın boşaltılıp otel hesabının ödendiği süreç; genellikle saat 10.00 ile 12.00 arasındadır. Daha geç çıkış çoğu zaman otelle önceden ayarlanabilir.
c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.gloss: Odayı geri verme ve son ödemenin yapıldığı işlem.

c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.translation: Uçuşum saat 17.00 olduğu için saat 11.00 yerine 14.00’te çıkabilir miyim?

c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.text: Can I check out at 14:00 instead of 11:00? My flight is at 17:00.
c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.translation: Bolehkah saya check-out pada pukul 14.00, bukan pukul 11.00? Penerbangan saya berangkat pukul 17.00.

c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.text: Can I check out at 14:00 instead of 11:00? My flight is at 17:00.
c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.translation: Posso fazer o check-out às 14h em vez das 11h? Meu voo é às 17h.

c7761e58969f7edd498186641b2021e8477e1bcd.translation: 十一時ではなく十四時にチェックアウトできますか。
